landingPage.headline: Your people are closer than you think.
landingPage.subheadline: Find nearby people and activities on your phone. Join a neighborhood plan or discover after-school activities with kids and parents from your school.

faqs.question: How does the map work?
faqs.answer: Choose a location and radius, then save your circle. Mirav shows approximate pins from completed profiles that have opted into visibility inside that area.

faqs.question: What is the Schools profile?
faqs.answer: A separate community for families, school staff and partners. Parents create and join nearby activities for their family. Discovery stays inside your saved circle and uses the same school website domain; this does not verify affiliation.

faqs.question: Who can see my details?
faqs.answer: You choose whether your profile is searchable. Pins are approximate, and contact details are shared only after both people accept that specific introduction.

faqs.question: Can Mirav care for my child?
faqs.answer: Mirav is an AI community guide. He can help you meet local people, but he is not a real babysitter and does not verify, vet or guarantee a caregiver.

faqs.question: Can I switch between communities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Neighborhood and Schools have separate profiles and saved areas. One profile is active at a time.
